gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-catamaran: Blunt, bold strokes with bowls left unfinished on one side. Comic Relief holds one steady pen pressure from first letter to last, while Catamaran gives the sans-serif text curvy, unclamped letters that feel approachable.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Comic Relief leaves its bowls unfinished on one side, bold and blunt. Chiron Hei HK has a bracelet-like c pulled wide apart, and in this sans the text moves along smoothly with a modern, businesslike feel.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-commissioner: Commissioner draws every stroke at a single thickness, giving the sans text a smooth surface with no clogged curves. Comic Relief heads it boldly, and the paragraphs glide on by.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-didact-gothic: Comic Relief goes bold and commanding, its bowls left unfinished on one side. Didact Gothic reads straight through without snagging on a closed-up bowl, each stroke carrying the same visual weight.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-dotgothic16: Comic Relief makes no fuss between up strokes and side strokes, and leaves its bowls unfinished on one side. DotGothic16 holds a tube-like thickness through every bend, with wide channels leading into each counter.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-doto: Wide margins of space surround each glyph in the body, and round letters get generous mouths. Doto is best at that spacious feel, while Comic Relief is best at bold curves that meet stems without swelling.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-el-messiri: Comic Relief gives its diagonals the same heft as its stems. El Messiri is the restful partner, with modest swings in stroke weight and a wide slot between the c's two ends.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-electrolize: Electrolize reads crisp and modern, its c open-jawed like a pair of pliers. Comic Relief leads with one-tip simplicity in every glyph, and the sans text keeps paragraphs moving at a contemporary clip.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-elms-sans: A ballpoint-plain line weight and a see-through gap in each s make the text read modern. Elms Sans looks best with its size nudged up, leaving Comic Relief free to stay bold.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-encode-sans: Encode Sans leaves gaps that keep its c from looking like an o. Encode Sans brings the clarity here, while Comic Relief runs curves and straights at a single width.
